title: ‘AMERICANS FLED’ — IRGC says PERSIAN GULF now has NO US VESSELS for FIRST TIME
text:
‘AMERICANS FLED’ — IRGC says PERSIAN GULF now has NO US VESSELS for FIRST TIME"

"NO AMERICAN SHIPS in PERSIAN GULF, HORMUZ, SEA OF OMAN or NORTHERN INDIAN OCEAN"

"FOR FIRST TIME SINCE 1853 — IRANIAN TOP OFFICIAL
